results.title: Social Media Platforms Are Training Their AI Models on Your Content, but You Can Stop Them (Sometimes)
results.description: There's not always an option to opt out of having your social media data harvested for AI, but if there is, it's here. Recently, the Amazon-owned Twitch made headlines for announcing that it would allow users to opt out of having their streams, VODs, and chats fed into an AI training machine.
